caption: Castello Aragonese, Otranto
composition: Limestone fortress on the Adriatic waterfront · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the seafront quay the camera faces the great limestone curtain wall of the Castello Aragonese, its massive cylindrical towers stepping away to the left. The Adriatic spreads at the left with a distant coastline on the horizon, and the quay stones fill the foreground. The 08:04 sun lights the weathered stone warmly.
